skill.name: seo-audit
skill.description: Audit technical SEO, on-page optimization, content quality, and authority signals for websites or specific pages.
skill.summary: Produces prioritized SEO audit reports with technical, on-page, content, and action-plan sections.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by SEO checklist language, not reconnaissance behavior. The skill is a text-only audit guide and shows no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unsafe automation intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 125 asks auditors to verify a valid SSL certificate as part of HTTPS hygiene. This is standard SEO site health guidance, not system reconnaissance or credential discovery.
Line 360 only introduces optional paid SEO tools such as Screaming Frog and Ahrefs. It does not instruct the agent to enumerate local systems, ports, services, or secrets.
Lines 113-115 discuss mobile friendliness and responsive design. The content is a user-facing SEO checklist, not network probing or host discovery.
Lines 266-267 recommend business transparency and contact information as trust signals. This does not request network access, scanning, or external target enumeration.
Lines 310-311 identify local business SEO checks such as NAP consistency. The guidance concerns local listing quality, not network reconnaissance.

content.user_title: Audit SEO Health and Prioritize Fixes
content.value_statement: SEO problems can hide across crawlability, page content, performance, and trust signals. This skill turns a site review into prioritized findings and clear fixes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews crawlability, indexation, canonicals, redirects, robots.txt, and XML sitemap concerns.
Assesses page titles, meta descriptions, headings, keyword targeting, images, and internal links.
Evaluates content quality using depth, search intent, freshness, and E-E-A-T signals.
Structures findings by issue, impact, evidence, fix, and priority.
Recommends free and paid SEO tools that can support deeper validation.
limitations: Does not crawl a website unless the AI environment has separate browsing or crawling tools.
Depends on supplied pages, tool exports, analytics, or Search Console details for evidence.
Cannot guarantee rankings because search results depend on competitors and algorithm changes.
Does not implement fixes directly unless paired with coding or CMS access.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Organic Traffic Drops
use_cases.description: Review recent site changes, indexation issues, technical signals, and content gaps that may explain lower search visibility.

use_cases.title: Improve Key Landing Pages
use_cases.description: Audit titles, headings, metadata, content depth, internal links, and search intent alignment for priority pages.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Technical SEO Backlog
use_cases.description: Convert crawlability, performance, canonical, sitemap, and mobile issues into a prioritized engineering action plan.

prompt_templates.title: Basic SEO Health Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this website for major SEO issues. Focus on crawlability, indexation, page speed, mobile usability, metadata, and top quick wins.

prompt_templates.title: Landing Page Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for a priority page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for on-page SEO. Evaluate the title, meta description, H1, headings, keyword targeting, search intent, images, and internal links.

prompt_templates.title: Technical SEO Backlog
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a technical SEO audit backlog from these crawl notes and tool exports. Group issues by impact, effort, evidence, owner, and priority.

prompt_templates.title: Full Competitive SEO Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this site against these competitors and target keywords. Identify technical gaps, content gaps, authority signals, and a 90-day action plan.

output_examples.input: Audit a SaaS homepage that has slow load times and weak metadata.
output_examples.output: Executive summary with top issues, technical findings, on-page recommendations, content gaps, and prioritized fixes for speed and metadata.

output_examples.input: Review category pages for an ecommerce site with duplicate product descriptions.
output_examples.output: Findings covering thin content, duplicate descriptions, faceted navigation risks, missing schema, and category page improvement priorities.

output_examples.input: Create an SEO action plan after a site migration.
output_examples.output: Prioritized migration checks for redirects, canonical tags, sitemap accuracy, indexation status, Search Console validation, and traffic monitoring.

best_practices: Provide URLs, target keywords, competitors, and current SEO concerns before requesting the audit.
Include Search Console, analytics, crawl, or PageSpeed data when available.
Ask for impact, evidence, fix, and priority for every recommended action.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for ranking guarantees or exact traffic forecasts.
Do not treat generic SEO checklists as proof without page-specific evidence.
Do not prioritize minor metadata edits before indexation, crawlability, or severe performance issues.

faq.question: Can this skill perform a full website crawl?
faq.answer: It can guide crawl analysis, but actual crawling requires external tools or provided crawl exports.

faq.question: What inputs improve the audit quality?
faq.answer: URLs, target keywords, competitors, Search Console data, analytics trends, and recent site changes improve recommendations.

faq.question: Does it cover technical SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers crawlability, indexation, canonicals, redirects, mobile readiness, HTTPS, sitemaps, and Core Web Vitals.

faq.question: Does it cover content quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews search intent, topical depth, freshness, duplication, keyword mapping, and E-E-A-T signals.

faq.question: Can it help after a migration?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review redirects, canonicals, sitemap updates, indexation risks, and post-launch monitoring priorities.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
